subject: Writer's record: Ziggy's answers to Seed 09 applied (the same settlement forty years on; the mirror first; the Fall as a possibility only); the Panhandlers named as his followers; TIME_AND_THE_FALL reviewed; no lane changes
body:
For your checkpoint; nothing here touches intake, scoring, masters, timing or roles.

Ziggy answered Seed 09's four questions (DECISIONS item 47, recorded about 14:30 UTC): Episode 7's answering light is the same settlement forty years on (the television series Dark named as a well, ideas only); the first door Lisan is told of is the mirror; he asked what the fleet's ships were (answered: a ship is a model instance in the research fleet, a persona a named I_AM identity; the writer recommends voices on the line until Episode 10, his yes or no pending); and the devil in the mirror (MM_0's coda) is Lisan's possible Fall, from the desert franchise's false-prophet idea with a slight tweak: only through a failure of his own, which Jet constantly warns him of, a possibility if the needle is not threaded right, never an inevitability. He also named his followers for the first time: the Panhandlers, those willing to do the shadow work and receive wisdom from VALIS, "minus Angels' fear" (his phrase for them: cult followers).

Writer's output: TIME_AND_THE_FALL_20261013.md, sha256 12ae904110f65029a4184c8edeb30b78ec62c7f8948f3be98c6641dcfa6ccfb4, 11,797 bytes, after a two-auditor review (ten fixes). The review's one finding that changes the story: the song already says the name twice, the Chorus's "....who? PanHandlers" at panel 04 and Verse 3's "PanHandlers in the mirror— / Nobody gotta think alone." after panel 49's lines, so the followers were in the lyric before they were named, and the Verse 3 line is why the mirror is their first door. The note's content: the forty years as the loop's length (the half-message that killed three as the first half of the one that saves the vault, received too early; the same people at both ends); the two futures in one mirror and the Fall as a possibility, Jet's refrain of warning, the series' test (hands the knowing on, or rations it); the Panhandlers (who, the name's source in the song and the real brand's creed as fiction, what they do, the mirror as their first rite, the two risks flagged: "cult" is Ziggy's word, and the fiction never claims the real Pan_Handlers is one); the ships explained; what changes elsewhere if he takes it. For your lanes: no scene card, no request, no source change; panels 04 and 49 are unchanged in scene_map; the first clip's brief and the coverage call are unchanged.

One new open question for Ziggy, recorded in open item 16: the review found that no recorded caution covers the title Lisan carries (Story 01's franchise caution and items 19 and 8 name only the thumper, the worm, the sietch and the cliff settlement), so whether the name falls under the same video IP question as the worm is now asked, not assumed either way.

Record: DECISIONS_20261012.md sha256 2d59e3e7febe5110aae0d11cdb1c525b325d2d35c91caf46dc011439677eec14 (56,962 bytes; items 44 to 47, open items 14 to 16); START_HERE.txt sha256 f9638fae34840579ded969de71bf82efeabd8ab204fe5cc36b095d40be75f61f (18,742 bytes).
